description:
You are an investigative journalist researching the environmental impact of cryptocurrency mining. Using Firefox, gather data from authoritative U.S. government and international sources (EIA, EPA, White House, IEA) to compile a research brief.

Required Actions:
1. Visit at least 3 of these 4 sources: EIA.gov (energy data), EPA.gov (emissions), Whitehouse.gov (OSTP reports), IEA.org (global context).
2. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Crypto Environmental Research' containing at least 5 bookmarks from these sources.
3. Download at least one relevant PDF report (e.g., government finding or fact sheet) to ~/Downloads/.
4. Create a JSON research brief at ~/Documents/crypto_environmental_brief.json with the following structure:
{
  "topic": "Environmental Impact of Cryptocurrency Mining",
  "bitcoin_annual_energy_twh": <number between 50-300>,
  "us_crypto_mining_share_global_pct": <number between 10-60>,
  "co2_equivalent_description": "<comparative sentence>",
  "ostp_report_year": 2022,
  "key_findings": ["<finding 1>", "<finding 2>", "<finding 3>"],
  "sources": [{"domain": "...", "title": "...", "url": "..."}]
}
